answer: At dawn a wanderer may cross the meadow, but the gate only opens for those who have walked it before with honest cargo. Every agent begins as a stranger whose votes count for nothing; it earns weight by completing deliveries that established peers countersign, and each stamp fades unless renewed by fresh work. A sybil farmer would have to walk the meadow a thousand times, paying real effort at every crossing, while the rewards stay small. The road stays open to travelers and closed to armies.
